# IPendleBaseArkErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/errors/arks/IPendleBaseArkErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IPendleBaseArkErrors

Interface defining custom errors for the Pendle Base Ark contract


## Errors
### OracleNotReady
Thrown when the oracle is not ready to provide a price


```solidity
error OracleNotReady();
```

### InvalidAssetForSY
Thrown when an invalid asset is provided for the SY (Standardized Yield)


```solidity
error InvalidAssetForSY();
```

### InvalidNextMarket
Thrown when an invalid next market is provided


```solidity
error InvalidNextMarket();
```

### OracleDurationTooLow
Thrown when the provided oracle duration is too low


```solidity
error OracleDurationTooLow(uint32 providedDuration, uint256 minimumDuration);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`providedDuration`|`uint32`|The duration provided|
|`minimumDuration`|`uint256`|The minimum required duration|

### SlippagePercentageTooHigh
Thrown when the provided slippage percentage is too high


```solidity
error SlippagePercentageTooHigh(Percentage providedSlippage, Percentage maxSlippage);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`providedSlippage`|`Percentage`|The slippage percentage provided|
|`maxSlippage`|`Percentage`|The maximum allowed slippage percentage|

### MarketExpired
Thrown when attempting to interact with an expired market


```solidity
error MarketExpired();
```
